description: NEXO brings together a multi-disciplinary group of problem-solvers, coders, and space enthusiasts passionate about leveraging open-source data to tackle real-world challenges. By bridging the gap between Earth science and space technology, our mission is to build scalable, high-impact solutions for real world challenges.
summary: COSMIC RUN 3D – Beyond the Universe is an immersive 3D space exploration game that combines endless runner gameplay with space science and educational experiences. Players navigate through challenging cosmic environments, avoid obstacles, collect rewards, and explore simulated journeys to destinations such as the Moon, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter. The project aims to make space exploration exciting, interactive, and educational through gamification.
details:
COSMIC RUN 3D – Beyond the Universe is an interactive 3D space exploration game developed to combine entertainment, technology, and scientific learning.

The game features an endless runner-style space environment where players control a spacecraft and navigate through challenging cosmic obstacles. Players can move, jump, slide, avoid laser barriers, and overcome different challenges while progressing through the game.

The project introduces a simulated space exploration journey featuring destinations such as the Moon, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter. Player performance and game scores are converted into simulated exploration distances, allowing players to visualize their progress toward different planetary milestones.

Key Features:

- Immersive 3D space environments.

- Interactive spacecraft movement and controls.

- Obstacle avoidance and laser challenges.

- Simulated planetary exploration.

- Score and distance tracking.

- Coins, XP, and achievement systems.

- Game progression and increasing difficulty.

- Mission reports displaying player progress.

- Mobile-friendly gameplay experience.

The main objective is to transform space science into an engaging gaming experience and encourage curiosity about the universe through interactive learning.
